description: This file contains autograd kernel indirection, fallback mechanisms, and utility functions for custom operations in PyTorch, specifically related to autograd and backward pass handling.

methods.name: autograd_kernel_indirection
methods.description: Creates an autograd kernel with indirection, allowing swapping of autograd implementations.

methods.name: autograd_not_implemented
methods.description: Provides a fallback kernel that raises an error if autograd is attempted on an unsupported operator.

methods.name: mark_non_differentiable
methods.description: Marks certain outputs as non-differentiable in the autograd context.

methods.name: construct_autograd_kernel
methods.description: Constructs a custom autograd kernel with forward and backward functions, handling pytree structures.

methods.name: gen_autograd_function
methods.description: Dynamically generates a subclass of torch.autograd.Function with specified forward and backward methods.

methods.name: namedtuple_args_cls
methods.description: Creates a namedtuple class for schema arguments, cached for reuse.

methods.name: namedtuple_args
methods.description: Instantiates a namedtuple for schema arguments from a tuple of args.

methods.name: validate_grad_inputs_dict
methods.description: Validates the gradient input dictionary returned by a backward function against the schema.

methods.name: grad_inputs_dict_to_flat_tuple
methods.description: Converts a gradient input dictionary into a flat tuple suitable for autograd.

methods.name: save_pytree_for_backward
methods.description: Saves a pytree of data onto the autograd context for backward pass.

methods.name: unpack_saved
methods.description: Unpacks saved data from the autograd context during backward pass.
